item.title: Today we're releasing two generative media models that make it easier and more cost-effective for enterprises and developers to build multimedia workf...
item.description:
Today we're releasing two generative media models that make it easier and more cost-effective for enterprises and developers to build multimedia workflows at scale.
Meet Nano Banana 2 Lite, our fastest and most cost-efficient Gemini Image model, and Gemini Omni Flash, which delivers high-quality video generation and conversational editing. By connecting them with the Interactions API, enterprises and developers can easily build custom multimedia applications and experiences from scratch.
To show you how these models work together, we built an e-commerce applet in Google AI Studio that turns product shots into cinematic videos. Just upload a photo, and Nano Banana 2 Lite generates brand-accurate images, while Gemini Omni Flash automatically turns the design into a brand new video.
Both models are available today in Google AI Studio, the Gemini API and the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. You can also find Nano Banana 2 Lite rolling out across AI Mode in Search, the Gemini app, and many other products.
Learn more → goo.gle/4vLTIHa

item.title: As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on our AI Tech Go-To-Market (GTM) team in Gurgaon, Shivank sits at the crucial intersection of customers and prod...
item.description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on our AI Tech Go-To-Market (GTM) team in Gurgaon, Shivank sits at the crucial intersection of customers and product. His daily mission is to help organizations shape their AI journeys by translating complex, real-world user needs directly into technical product updates.
Recently, he put this into practice by working closely with the CTO and leadership team of one of India's largest companies. "This was an extremely meaningful and inspiring project as I got an opportunity to positively impact the lives of so many employees of such a large organization," Shivank says. "Collaboration truly drives us at Google and forms the backbone of all our work. It’s actually the environment here that makes everyone so interested in working together."
Ready to bring your engineering expertise directly to the front lines of client innovation? Explore how you can shape the future of technology and find your next team as a Forward Deployed Engineer → https://goo.gle/3PUwMWc

item.title: The new Google Finance is coming out of beta this week, rolling out globally today with new features and capabilities. 🟢 With portfolios, you’ll b...
item.description:
The new Google Finance is coming out of beta this week, rolling out globally today with new features and capabilities.
🟢 With portfolios, you’ll be able to view your performance data and get helpful insights on your investments. Your existing Google Finance portfolios will be available automatically — or you can create a new one by uploading spreadsheets, files or even screenshots of your holdings.
🟢 Google Finance can now keep you updated on market intel and deliver a custom briefing on your preferred schedule. Simply describe a task like, “Send me a daily pre-market briefing analyzing significant overnight moves across major cryptocurrencies.” When your update is ready, you’ll receive a notification through the Google app for Android or iOS, as well as in the research panel in Google Finance on the web. This feature is also rolling out globally today.
🟢 Keep up with the market on the go with the new Google Finance app for Android. You’ll be able to access your watchlist, real-time data, a live financial news feed and the AI research tool. Even more features and an iOS app are coming soon.
Learn more about Google Finance → goo.gle/3QJcSxZ

item.title: Great teaching is built on the human connection between a teacher and student. As technology evolves, our goal isn't to replace that connection, but t...
item.description:
Great teaching is built on the human connection between a teacher and student. As technology evolves, our goal isn't to replace that connection, but to support it.
At ISTE, we showcased new tools across Google Classroom, Chromebooks and Gemini designed to keep educators at the forefront of AI and providing students with personalized support.
Key updates include: - Study notebooks in Gemini that create personalized lessons and quizzes that adapt as a student learns. - A new Classroom app in Gemini that helps educators with everyday tasks using their class context.
Coming soon: - Teacher-led AI activities in Google Classroom that are grounded in a school’s curriculum and give insights into student understanding. - No-cost ACT and GRE practice tests developed in partnership with The Princeton Review. Guided Learning tools for Chromebooks to help students stay focused.
To further our commitment, our Google Educator Series is providing free AI training to every educator in the U.S. in partnership with ISTE+ASCD.
Learn more about all of our education updates from ISTE ➡️ https://goo.gle/4xQqdFp

item.title: In a new policy paper released today, Kent Walker shares how a pragmatic approach to AI governance in America can help ensure that everyone benefits f...
item.description:
In a new policy paper released today, Kent Walker shares how a pragmatic approach to AI governance in America can help ensure that everyone benefits from AI. Learn more ⬇️While the promise and pace of AI are remarkable, the debate over AI governance is at a deadlock, with some calling for heavy regulation and others pushing for little or none to maximize innovation.
In a new policy paper released today, we suggest a middle way—one designed specifically for the realities of both frontier models and widely-deployed AI applications.
See how the right governance frameworks can help us capture AI’s massive potential without slowing down innovation. → https://lnkd.in/eEpM2Uxv
